title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer, which is Z/137.

title: Use of Constants
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify and use the fine-structure constant in their calculations.

title: Application of Bohr Model
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply the Bohr model correctly to derive the relationship between speed and atomic number Z.

title: Equation Setup
description: Important Criteria: The student should set up the equations relating mass, speed, and radius accurately.

title: Dimensional Analysis
description: Optional Criteria: The student may perform dimensional analysis to verify the consistency of their final answer.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as miscalculating the relationship between speed and Z.
